fields.name: clientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.hint: The dashboard reads Strava through an API app of your own. On strava.com/settings/api: create an app (any name, category and website; Authorization Callback Domain: localhost), then copy its Client ID here. Strava asks for a subscription to make one, and a new app lets only its owner sign in, which is all this frame needs.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.hint: Under the Client ID: show the Client Secret and copy it. It stays in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password.

fields.name: signIn
fields.label: Sign-in address
fields.hint: Once the frame shows Sign in: open the sign-in page it links to (its QR code on the frame, or a new tab from the editor's preview), press Authorize with "View data about your activities" ticked, then copy the address the browser lands on and paste it here. That page does not open, which is expected: its address has the code in it. The frame signs in with it and empties this field; paste a new one to sign in again.

fields.name: redirectUri
fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.hint: Where Strava sends the browser after the sign-in. Strava always allows localhost, so keep this one.

options.label: Cycling (rides of every kind, virtual rides)

fields.name: goal
fields.label: Weekly goal
fields.hint: How far you want to go each week, in kilometers or miles as Units says (a swim goal too: 5 is 5 km). 0: no goal.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

strava.name: Strava
strava.description: Your week of running, cycling or swimming from Strava: this week's distance and time against a weekly goal, the last eight weeks as bars, the year's totals and your last activities with their pace. Signs in with a Strava API app of your own.
